about: S3b C11: the config answers of the pinned sqlfluff (scripts/s3b/config_oracle.py; docs/interfaces/config.md). A value keeps its Python type: {"int": text}, {"float": repr}, {"dict": {...}}. defaults and base: [key path, value] of each setting. load: the settings that are not those of base, or the error. cli: the stdout (with -m: the tree with no position keys), the exit code, and the warning lines of stderr with no color of "sqlfluff parse -f json". sqll: what sqll must do (null: the same; unsupported; exit2). jinja_as_raw: the dialect fixtures that are not empty and have no Jinja delimiter, whose Jinja templated file is that of the raw templater (text, sliced file, raw slices).
command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3b/config_oracle.py record
